subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses present, past and future tenses; identifies and uses nouns, verbs and pronouns correctly

show.line: Naming words name things. Dog, ball, Mama. Doing words tell what we do. Run, jump, eat. The dog runs!

rounds.prompt: Which word is a naming word, a thing you can see?
rounds.praise: Yes! Ball is a naming word.

rounds.prompt: Which word is a doing word? Something you can do.
rounds.praise: Yes! Swim is a doing word.

rounds.prompt: The girl kicks the ball. Which word is the doing word? Say it.
Thabo is tall. Which little word can take the place of Thabo?
Mama and I are going to the shop. Which word takes the place of Mama and I?
rounds.praise: Yes! We are going to the shop.

rounds.prompt: Naming word or doing word? Put each word in its group.
Tomorrow I, gap, to the park. Which word fits?
rounds.praise: Will go! Tomorrow has not happened yet.

hints: Can you see it or touch it? Then it is a naming word.
Can you do it? Then it is a doing word.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! The boy eats an apple. I will find the doing word.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Apple! Apple is the doing word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! You cannot apple. Eats is the doing word.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's find it together. What does the boy do? He eats. Eats!

parent_line: Can tell naming words from doing words and use he, she, it and we.
